newsitem.title: USA: CME Sept lumber end limit up on fund buying, stops.
newsitem.headline: CME Sept lumber end limit up on fund buying, stops.

text.p: Renwed fund buying at the close touched off buy stops and September CME lumber futures closed up their $10.00 limit, with other months higher to sharply higher, traders said.
Lumber closed limit up to 0.050 lower with only distant July off and September limit up at $381.00 per tbf. July ended up $6.50 at $392.40.

Scattered buying offset early profit taking and futures moved up as fund short covering increased. The late fund buy order in September offset another round of profit to push prices up into the stops, traders said.

Recent strength in futures stemmed from the rising cash prices. Expectations of reduced production concern over labor negotiations in British Columbia and recent forest fires in canada also combined to push futures up, they added.
Random Lengths quoted cash spruce at $372 per tbf, up $10 from midweek and $18 above last Friday's level.
Cargill Investor Services notably bought September into the close, pit sources said.
